body.name: Finite-population response class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_N=\{(Y_i(a,t))_{i\in\mathcal I,a\in\mathcal A,t\in[0,1]}\in[0,1]^{\mathcal I\times\mathcal A\times[0,1]}: \mu_{xa}(s)\leq\mu_{xa}(t)\text{ and }|\mu_{xa}(t)-\mu_{xa}(s)|\leq\Gamma|t-s|\text{ for every }x\in\mathcal X,a\neq a_0,0\leq s\leq t\leq1,\text{ and }\mu_{x a_0}(s)=\mu_{x a_0}(t)\text{ for every }x,s,t\}\).
